quest.title: The Orioles Bask in Spring, the Heavens Present Auspices
quest.description: You and Paimon return to Liyue, preparing to take part in the annual Lantern Rite. As expected, there are familiar faces to be seen as you walk around the harbor...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

chapter.num: Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze: Part I
chapter.title: The Orioles Bask in Spring, the Heavens Present Auspices

talks.objective: Take a walk around Liyue Harbor

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Keqing! And Charlotte? Paimon never thought she'd see you two together.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: #Nice to see you again, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, we're not interrupting anything, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Not at all. I wasn't in the middle of an interview or anything. I was just asking Miss Keqing about purchasing a kite.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A kite? Are you buying some regional specialties to bring back to Fontaine?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Well, yes. And...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: It seems you haven't heard yet. The theme of this year's Lantern Rite is "Kites."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! So that's why Paimon has seen so many floating in the sky!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Liyue Harbor is always changing, so it is only fitting that Lantern Rite should change in turn.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: The Qixing believes it would benefit Liyue to build on our own cultural foundation by embracing the technologies of other nations. After all, it is said that "the stones of another mountain may serve to better polish one's own jade."

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: So, Ningguang organized a private meeting with Miss Charlotte to ask for her help in fostering cooperation with the right people.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Yeah, remember my "business meeting" with Tianquan Ningguang the last time I was in Liyue Harbor? That's what it was about.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: But, all I really did was use my network to introduce Lady Ningguang to some interesting people. I'm not sure that quite counts as "fostering cooperation"...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: In the end, we decided to combine Liyue's traditional art of kite-making with Fontaine's "Mechanical Vertical Lifting Device."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mechanical... Lifting Device? Sounds pretty impressive!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But don't kites just use the wind to fly? Why would you need to add something mechanical?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Well, you've actually just answered your own question, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: How high and far a kite can fly depends as much on the weather conditions as on the skill of the person holding the string.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: But as soon as there's no wind, you can only flail about helplessly like a Sweet-Flower Medaka out of water. Experience doesn't matter at that point.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Exactly. Liyue is now a nation ruled by humans after all. It's about time we had the power to make a kite fly, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Plus, the easier we can make it to enjoy, the more people will want to participate!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Right!? I also thought it was a novel idea! Plus, it shouldn't cost much to do.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: With Miss Charlotte's help, everything has gone smoothly. Our new mechanical kites are already available to purchase from a stall in the harbor. We're having trouble keeping up with demand.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: We also gave quite a bit of thought to the price. We didn't want it to be too much more expensive than a traditional kite.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cool! Turns out you two and Ningguang like playing with toys just as much as Paimon!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Toys? They're not exactly toys...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: You see, Miss Keqing? That does seem to be everyone's first reaction.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Hmm, although kites are one of our most time-honored cultural relics, outside of their use in certain ceremonies, I suppose they're considered "playthings" more than anything now.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: But to me, they're so much more than that.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Think for a second about how remarkable it is that a flimsy paper kite attached to a string has the capacity to touch the sky. It is this slight piece of paper that also carries the weight of Liyue's cultural traditions.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: There's an old poem that goes, "O kite borne of paper flying true and sound, a lone traveler wanders just waiting to be found, send them love, send them word, send them homeward bound."

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: In the past, poets from Liyue used kites to symbolize a feeling of longing or evoke the peacefulness of idyllic rural scenery.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: If the people of today can derive enjoyment from this activity, they will not only be more likely to better appreciate the tradition, but also to pass it down to the people of tomorrow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's the Keqing we know, always thinking five steps ahead of anyone else...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Well said, Miss Keqing! I've learned quite a bit myself.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Haha, as long as you're willing to listen, I'm happy to share.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I also know quite a lot about the various folk traditions related to kites.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: For example, whenever a kite blew away, people would say it was the Adepti that summoned the wind to take it away as an offering. That way, you can turn an unfortunate event into an auspicious one.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What about something more fun? Do you know anything like that?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: More fun... Hmm, let me think. Oh, I suppose we should first talk about how kites are made. It's another one of our precious forms of traditional craftsmanship.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: My grandfather told me that, back when he was a boy, children learned the art of kite-making step by step from their elders.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: First, you use thin strips of bamboo to construct the frame, then you draw a design of your choice on a piece of paper, paste it onto the frame, and tie on the string...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Then you look towards the sky and release the kite to soar among the clouds.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Some people write down certain names or desires on their kites, cut the string, and let them fly free. Others may place particular thoughts or meaning into the design itself.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Are certain designs associated with certain meanings? I'm going to jot all of this down.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Hmm... Well, for example, kites in the shape of a butterfly typically symbolize freedom, happiness, or the desire to break free.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Fascinating! What else can you tell me?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: The scissor-tailed swallow is the most classic design. It symbolizes good fortune and joyful tidings. Different colors also have small variations in meaning.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Are these commonly understood meanings and symbols in Liyue? Kind of like the language of flowers in Fontaine.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I believe so. Most have probably heard something about it from their elders at some point.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: If you're interested, Miss Charlotte, I have several books on the topic that I could lend you. They could be a useful reference.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: That would be a huge help!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Great, looks like I've got the outline for quite the article on my hands!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hope it goes well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Perfect! We're gonna take a look around.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Then I'll show Miss Charlotte to my home for a little while.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Ah, I almost forgot. The Ministry of Civil Affairs is hosting a kite-flying contest on the night of Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, if you're interested, you're more than welcome to bring a kite and participate.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: The rules are simple. Whoever flies their kite the highest and furthest within the time limit will receive a special honor along with a secret prize.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I've already prepared more than enough empty film for the event. I can see the spectacle already!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon was on board the moment you said "secret prize!"

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Then I'll look forward to seeing your performance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You bet, see you then!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wait, {NICKNAME}! Take a peek to your right... Do you see those two people lurking over there?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yeah, I see them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is it just Paimon, or were they staring at us the whole time we were talking to Keqing and Charlotte just now? They seem fishy.

choices.text: The Qixing do attract a lot of attention.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Well, yes. But...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Something's up. Paimon just has a bad feeling.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Do you think they could be Treasure Hoarders? They always seem to be stirring up trouble during Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's sick of waiting around for something bad to happen. We should strike first! You know, foil their plans before they even begin!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You go right. Paimon will go left!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wait, Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great, so it wasn't just Paimon.

choices.text: We've got it in the bag.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Uh, maybe tone it down a bit, {NICKNAME}. What if we don't win?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's better to keep a low profile until the competition starts. Then, we'll give them a show they never saw coming! That secret prize is ours!

dialogues.text: Oh?
It is with such an air of urgency that you appear before us. Your comportment suggests you believe us to have committed some heinous crime. Perhaps you could enlighten us as to your intentions.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woah, where did this fuddy-duddy come from?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You should be the one doing the enlightening, buddy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't think we didn't notice you eavesdropping! One look and we could tell you were up to no good. Tell us everything, starting with your name!
Uh...
One bears no secrets before two such as yourselves. You stand in the presence of the mighty and illuminated adeptus, Moon Carver.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: For the purpose of this foray into the mortal realm, however, you may address one as Houzhang.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pfft, you kidding!? That deer's got his head stuck so far up in the clouds, there's no way he'd humble himself down here with the rest of us.
*ahem* You may want to hold your tongue, Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ha, don't think that Paimon is going to believe you just because you know her name. Let Paimon guess, you're supposed to be Mountain Shaper, right?

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Indeed! Moon Carver and myself have descended upon the mortal realm for a visit. The two of you may call me Jiehu.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like you did your research. But in our experience, the harder you try to lead us on, the more likely it is that we've got a big fish on our hands!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, we'll go straight to the Millelith and have you arrested for impersonating Adepti!

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Preposterous! Utterly preposterous!

choices.text: If you really are who you claim to be...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right! Tell us something that only an Adeptus would know, and it better not be some common knowledge that any person on the street could tell you.

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: *sighs*

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: During the last Lantern Rite, we gathered at Mt. Hulao with Rex Lapis and made use of Cloud Retainer's Supreme Cuisine Machine to prepare Bamboo Shoot Soup. Perhaps you have some recollection?

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: The flavor of that soup was more than enough to whet one's appetite. As such, Cloud Retainer assented to my use of the device beyond that singular occasion, providing other recipes, to boot. Since then, one has dabbled in the pleasures of the culinary arts whenever time allows.

response.speaker: Houzhang
response.text: Dabbled? Upon one's last sojourn to your mountain, did you not immediately attempt to hide the device behind a chunk of amber as soon as one's presence was known?

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: Uh...

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: Did one not speak up on your behalf but a moment ago? This is how you choose to repay that kindness?

response.speaker: Houzhang
response.text: One is simply trying to emphasize the veracity of our claim.

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: That does not mean you should reveal personal matters so readily. They might think one bears no difference from Cloud Retainer. *sigh* Forget it, one does not have the breath to waste on such petty trifles.

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: You may recall that, in order to preserve the tranquility of one's mountain, one planted karst crawlers around Mt. Hulao.

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: In fact, the seeds are one of Streetward Rambler's cultivars. Among all the Adepti, her horticultural skill is preeminent.

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: The plant neither wilts nor withers and its practical use is undeniable. Yet, it does require quite the upkeep. After a while, one tires of the effort.

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: Thus, one had no choice but to foray into town to inquire from Streetward Rambler a gentler and more easily managed variety.

response.speaker: Houzhang
response.text: On your way, you were accosted by a group of youths and, without revealing your true form, were unable to extricate yourself of their presence. If one's memory serves, Streetward Rambler had to personally come to your rescue.

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: Uh...

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: How did you come into possession of such knowledge?

response.speaker: Houzhang
response.text: The young lass, Yaoyao, keeps no secrets from Cloud Retainer.

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: ...*sigh* Alas, one can only let bygones be bygones...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I suppose they really are the adepti...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, that might've been more detail than we needed... Seems like you two are the real deal and Paimon's sorry for suspecting you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But uh, for beings as forgiving as yourselves, this is just water under the bridge... right?

choices.text: Take it as a compliment to the quality of your disguise...

response.speaker: Houzhang
response.text: #You indeed have an agile mind, {NICKNAME}. Cloud Retainer was not mistaken in her high estimation of you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's still curious about something. It's just...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can understand why Mountain Shaper is here, but why did you decide to come to the city, Moon Carver? It's not really your thing, is it?

response.speaker: Houzhang
response.text: Hmph...

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: *sighs*

response.speaker: Houzhang & Jiehu
response.text: It is but an inevitable eventuality...

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: It is but an inevitable eventuality...

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: Long have the mountains remained strangely idle since Cloud Retainer's move to Liyue Harbor.

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: With Lantern Rite near at hand, one would expect Cloud Retainer to provide us with an account of the festivities in advance. Yet, to this day, she has failed to appear.

response.speaker: Houzhang
response.text: Cloud Retainer is hardly the forgetful sort.

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: One must never rest idle in the face of that which demands action. And since our acquaintances dwell in Liyue Harbor, we had to travel here in human form to avail ourselves of their aid — Cloud Retainer's, in this case.

response.speaker: Houzhang
response.text: But a moment ago, one heard you speak of a... mechanical kite of sorts. It appears the essence of the situation has hitherto revealed itself. Now it is time for one to retire back to one's abode.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? So you're not looking for Cloud Retainer anymore?

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: Perhaps there are aspects of Cloud Retainer's temperament that remain opaque to young Paimon. Given one's understanding, one can only imagine the anger that now consumes her...

response.speaker: Houzhang
response.text: Cloud Retainer is of a proud and arrogant disposition. She holds the belief that her skill in mechanics surpasses that of all others. One can be quite certain it is hardly with an open mind that she regards the arrival of this new technology.

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: One surmises that she has shut herself away, refused all company, and buried herself in the study of her own creations... To call on her would only invite her rebuke.

response.speaker: Jiehu
response.text: However, if you do happen to cross paths with her over the next few days, do pass along one's regards.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure! Leave it to us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Have a safe trip back, enjoy the scenery, and happy Lantern Rite!

response.speaker: Houzhang
response.text: Thank you for your kind words. We shall now depart.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We got all worked up for nothing, huh? All that trouble and it turned out to be people we knew all along...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, it's still pretty early. Let's head over and check out the kite stalls.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon wants to see what kinds of kites we can buy to use in the competition. The bigger and prettier the better!

choices.text: Few people will be able to see through it!

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: Welcome! Are the two of you looking to buy a kite? Would you like me to go over the different designs?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, a scissor-tailed swallow! And a butterfly! And... Oh!

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: Ah, this Jade Chamber design is our newest. It's been selling like crazy over the past two days.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Does it also have a unique meaning?

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: Of course. The Jade Chamber symbolizes wealth and abundance. The kite bearing its design is said to bring riches in the future to those who fly it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Now that's Paimon's kind of kite!

dialogues.speaker: Longzhou
dialogues.text: I apologize for the interruption but are all your wares in order, Miss Zhenyuan?

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: Yes, yes, they're just over there. The paper, bamboo, and dyes... All the necessary kite-making materials.

dialogues.speaker: Longzhou
dialogues.text: Wonderful. I'll pack them up and get a guard to deliver the goods to Yilong Wharf for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yilong Wharf? Oh, wonder what that place is like during Lantern Rite. Paimon would love to go take a look!

dialogues.speaker: Longzhou
dialogues.text: If the two of you are interested in going to Yilong Wharf, then could I trouble you to find Gaming and deliver these goods together?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is Gaming the guard you just mentioned?

dialogues.speaker: Longzhou
dialogues.text: Yes. The Communications Office handles shipments and transports around Liyue. He works for the Secure Transport Agency, one of our sub-organizations.

dialogues.speaker: Longzhou
dialogues.text: The problem is, many of my colleagues have taken leave during Lantern Rite to spend time with their families. So, our available workforce has seen a dramatic decrease recently.

dialogues.speaker: Longzhou
dialogues.text: If you were willing to help out, then I could get a head start on my next appointment...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You do seem really pressed for time...

response.speaker: Longzhou
response.text: Wonderful! You will of course be compensated for your efforts!

response.speaker: Longzhou
response.text: Now, at this time of day... Gaming should be somewhere in the vicinity. Just follow the main road until you see the head of a Wushou dance costume. Should be on your right.

response.speaker: Zhenyuan
response.text: Be sure to come back if you'd like to buy a kite! I'll even give you a discount!

response.speaker: Longzhou
response.text: Of course, of course! Hard work deserves ample rewards.

talks.objective: Follow the instructions to find Gaming

dialogues.text: Wait, I thought we had an agreement? Loser buys dim sum tomorrow. Look at you, scowl like that for much longer, and your face might stay that way.
Hey now, don't be upset. How about this, you extend the invitation, and I'll pay.

dialogues.speaker: Xiaqing
dialogues.text: No way, Gaming! You're always the one picking up the tab.

dialogues.speaker: Xiaqing
dialogues.text: I'm not trying to be a sore loser, I just... didn't expect you to come from behind to win like that.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Hehe, that was nothing. All in a day's work, friend.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Perfect! Gaming is here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry to interrupt, Gaming. We just spoke to a guy from the Communications Office who needs you to deliver some goods to Yilong Wharf.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Oh! Must have been Longzhou. Looks like I've got work. Gotta go!

dialogues.speaker: Xiaqing
dialogues.text: Sure, go do your thing.

dialogues.speaker: Xiaqing
dialogues.text: Let's have a rematch when you get back. I won't let you win so easily next time.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Alrighty, you can hand the goods over to me. Must have been heavy hauling them all this way. Let me take them off your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh, it wasn't that bad. It's just some kite-making materials. Plus, we didn't have to walk very far.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Kite-making materials... I see, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: I'm glad it wasn't too much trouble, Paimon. Still, I owe you one!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: #And you must be {NICKNAME}! It's nice to meet you! Thanks for your help!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You know us?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Haha, there probably aren't many in Liyue who don't. I've heard quite a bit about you two, you're quite well-known around these parts!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Oh! And please excuse Longzhou if he forgot to thank you. Take my thanks in his place.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: He's a good guy. He's just been super busy lately, running around from place to place... Don't be too hard on him, yeah?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: So, you here for Lantern Rite?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep! It's always so lively this time of year. We were actually hoping we could tag along to Yilong Wharf and have a look around.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Perfect! We'll go together then!

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: I'm good with directions, so just follow me. Trust me, I know my way around. We can exchange stories, tell jokes, or just chat along the way.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Oh, and there are a couple of good places to eat along our route. We can stop and grab a bite when it's time.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: The ingredients are fresh, the portions are generous, and the prices won't break the bank. You can order anything and I promise you won't be disappointed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Order anything...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon seems to be drooling already.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, did you really have to call Paimon out like that in front of our new friend?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Don't worry! I understand. I joke around like that with my friends, too. It just shows how close you are.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: You need to pack anything up before we hit the road? I can wait.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nope. Our things are always packed and ready. We're pretty much travel experts at this point.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Oh! That's right! Then let's get going. If we run into any trouble, you can count on me to protect you. I am a guard after all.

talks.objective: Go to Chenyu Vale with Gaming

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That was terrifying... Even Paimon couldn't get a word in.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Ah, sorry. They mean well, it's just...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: *sigh*... I don't want to talk about it. Let's get these things delivered first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's okay. Whenever you're ready to talk about it, we'll be ready to listen.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Seems like we really can't go anywhere without running into Treasure Hoarders, can we?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Yeah, it's not uncommon for deliveries to get intercepted. That's why this job needs guards like us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon was impressed by your moves back there. You seem like a real pro at your job.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Oh! That's not a skill I learned on the job. It's just a hobby.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Have you ever heard of Wushou dancing?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Really? Wushou dancing is famous in Chenyu Vale.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Performers might be invited to promote the opening of a business or to spread good fortune during a holiday season.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: But I must admit, it has nothing on the popularity of the Liyue opera.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: I'm also well aware that people in Liyue Harbor aren't exactly jumping at the chance to watch Wushou dancing... So it's not something I do full-time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? You have two jobs? How do you have the energy to do all that?

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: It's not that tiring. You just have to take a rest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, Paimon gets it. So you must sleep a lot then.

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Not really. Just yesterday, I stayed up all night playing cards.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, uh...

response.speaker: Gaming
response.text: Let's go. The docks are just up ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Gaming walks forward and exchanges a few words with a boatman near the docks. The next thing you know, he's called for everyone to board a bamboo raft...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Finally, we can rest! Paimon's shoulders are so stiff, and her stomach's so empty...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Sorry, sorry! Did I push the pace a bit too much? I mean, you were the ones who said you were travel experts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Liyue's just too hilly. Floating up and down so much wears Paimon out. *sigh* Paimon was finally satisfied, and now her poor stomach's empty again...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Would you like some Winter Melon Cake? I have some on me that I bought from a store.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes! Paimon'll take all you've got!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: You might want to pace yourself there or you'll be too full to eat a proper meal later.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pfft, Paimon never gets too full! Just like... Oh! Just like you, apparently, never get tired, no matter how far you walk or how many jobs you work.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: #Ah, I see. Then here you go, Paimon. And for you, {NICKNAME}. Enjoy!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: And here's some for you too, Uncle Bosu. Don't think I forgot about you, my friend. I'll just set it to the side here for ya.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Gaming seems like a real people person. He can get along with anyone, and he treats every person he meets like a close friend.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, that hit the spot! Paimon thought she was going to starve to death for a minute there!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Ha, that close of a call, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: I've been eating Winter Melon Cake ever since I was a kid. You can buy them from all sorts of places, whether it's a small vendor on the side of the road or a big restaurant in the city, but each place produces cakes with a slightly different flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: If you like these ones, I can give you the address of the shop I bought them from. I'll just have to check when we get back.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Ah! All my jabbering must be making it difficult for you to enjoy the scenery in peace. Don't be afraid to tell me to zip it for a little while, okay? Really, I won't be offended.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's okay! Paimon is kind of enjoying listening to your chitter-chatter.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Aw, a fed Paimon is a happy Paimon, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Paimon can be in a good mood any time she wants!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woohoo, we're here!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Don't forget your things, and watch your step as you get off the raft or, you're in for a swim.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Thanks for the ride, Uncle Bosu. You take care of yourself now. I'll see you some other time!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Okay, follow me. This way is fastest. We'll have to take the elevator up to the Secure Transport Agency.

talks.objective: Go to the Secure Transport Agency

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Oh, well... Uh, how should I put it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, spit it out!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: ...Do you see that group of people over there?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Those are my relatives.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, you sure have a big family.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Once they start buying things, they won't stop perusing till it gets dark. This is bad...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pfft, they're your family, not your arch-enemies. What's there to be afraid of? Unless... Oh, did you do something horrible to them?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: No, it's not that.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: I'm just... not that good at dealing with my family.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: It would be best if we could steer clear of them...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: I'll explain more when we have the chance. But right now, we've got a job to do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then we'll just have to sneak past them.

talks.objective: Follow Gaming and try to avoid his relatives's notice as much as possible
Follow Gaming and try to avoid his relatives's notice as much as possible

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: #Hey, Uncle Zhigui. These are my friends, {NICKNAME}, and Paimon. They came to deliver some goods with me.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: So, I guess I'll go ahead and take these over to Uncle Yongzan, then?

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Yes. Thanks for your hard work!

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: I should thank you both for your trouble as well. Please take a seat and rest for a bit. I'll prepare some tea.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No need. We'll be off soon anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Hey, we're already here, aren't we? No harm in taking a load off for a bit. Plus, I know the Secure Transport Agency has some great "Sunglo Tea" stashed around here somewhere. I promise you, one sip and you'll be hooked!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Anyway, you just sit down and relax, Uncle Zhigui. Who would I be if I just sat here and let you go through all this trouble? Leave this to me.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: I have to be up and about to drop these goods off anyway. What's a little extra time on my feet?

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: #You aren't too picky, right {NICKNAME}? I know Paimon prefers things on the sweeter side, so I won't steep the tea too long, and I'll add some dim sum pastries on the side.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww? You noticed what Paimon likes?

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: How long have you two known Gaming?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, not long at all. We just kinda tagged along on his trip to Yilong Wharf.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's just a super welcoming guy. We became friends... Y'know, just like that!

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Haha, that's just how he is. He's the attentive sort — really knows how to look after his own.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: A while ago, one of our guards had to take off work. Said his joints were hurting due to the rain.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Gaming personally went all the way to Bubu Pharmacy to get some medicine for him from Dr. Baizhu, then traveled through the night to deliver it back to him.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: That young man has such a good head on his shoulders. How can anyone not love him?

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: I mean, there is his dad, but ask anyone else...

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Uncle Yongzan says that he doesn't have the personnel to spare for this delivery right now. So, what do you think, Uncle Zhigui? Should I go ahead and deliver it instead?

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Ah, it feels like we've troubled you enough already.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: It's kite-making materials, though. Could be for a kid.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: I'm sure the sender wants it delivered before Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Oh! By the way, here, have some tea.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The refreshing aroma and lingering aftertaste of the "Sunglo Tea" invigorates your spirits.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Alright then. Deliver it if you want to.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Ooh, are you free in two days? How about we grab some dim sum from Xinyue Kiosk? My treat — and don't even think about trying to pay.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woah... That's way too generous of you!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Ah, don't mention it! Just think of this as a thank you for all your help. Besides, the thing between me and my family... It's a long story. It might take some time to tell.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds good! Paimon never says no to free food!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you at Xinyue Kiosk, then.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Alright, then I'm off. See you in two days! Oh, and Paimon, make sure not to eat too much before then. Don't say I didn't warn you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is he underestimating Paimon? Hah! She's just gonna have to show him how much she can really eat!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, is Gaming's family situation really that complicated?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He has such a happy-go-lucky personality. Plus, he's an enthusiastic and diligent worker. It's hard to imagine a guy like that being troubled by much...

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Hm... How should I put it...

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Since he already plans to tell you himself, you don't need an old man like me to add my two cents.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: You seem to be around the same age, so you might have a lot in common.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Perhaps you could help him talk things through... Consider it a favor to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll try.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you have the time, maybe you can make a little flag for us to wave about.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It can say: "We provide aid in spades!" Couldn't hurt to advertise our services, right?

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Well, I can certainly arrange that! Is there anything else you want it to say?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, seriously? Paimon was just joking, but if you're going to get us something, she'd much rather have Winter Melon Cake instead.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Haha, seems like Gaming really has rubbed off on you.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Would you like some more tea? I think there's some left.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No thanks. We came all this way and still haven't gotten a chance to look around the wharf.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should see the kinds of kites they've got. Maybe they'll have ones you can't find in Liyue Harbor!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's not a bad idea.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Alright then. Please do let me know if you'd like more tea. You're welcome to stay as long as you like.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "It's Gaming!"

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: With the cry of Gaming's name, his relatives begin to surround you from all directions.

talks.objective: Go to the Secure Transport Agency to deliver the goods

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: The way you speak, one might have presumed you were displeased to be in one's presence.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Take note, Paimon. You could learn a thing or two about how to respect your elders.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Starting on the "elder" stuff already, huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Shouldn't you be back in your cave tinkering away at some kite-related thingamabob or something? What brings you out here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And what's with that huge box next to you... Ah, Paimon gets it! You're here to do some shopping, aren't you?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: And what of it?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: The Qixing's decision to integrate Fontainian technology into said kite-flying competition is of no consequence to oneself.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Did you expect one to wilfully compete against the whimsical trends of worldly sentiment, or perhaps even fall to petty sulking over such?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... It's not that we think those things exactly... That's just what Mountain Shaper and Moon Carver told us! Or, Jie something and Hou...? Paimon can't be bothered to remember what their aliases were called.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, they went to Liyue Harbor to look for you. They even asked us to pass along their regards if we ran into you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Xianyun?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Did she... forget about them?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: (It appears time has quite flown since one's arrival in Liyue Harbor. How could one have forgotten about those two old fossils?)

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: (One shall have to bring them back some divine herbs to atone for this slight... Nay, given that one has ventured all this way to Yilong Wharf, tea would be more advisable.)

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: A great thought has illuminated one's mind once again. One is reminded that certain purchases have yet to be made.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Perhaps you two could wait here whilst one performs this task. It'll be but a moment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Wait here? You're really just gonna ditch us here to watch your stuff?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That woman really just does whatever she wants.

choices.text: Let me go see what she's up to.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hey, not you too, {NICKNAME}! All this Paimon-ditching is super not appreciated!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, just... come back soon, okay? Paimon... Paimon doesn't want anyone to try and steal this stuff!

response.speaker: Fenglian
response.text: Welcome! Please have a look around. We only sell teas of the finest quality, sourced directly from Qiaoying Village. Might I recommend the Sunglo variety? It's one of our specialties!

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: (Now, that sounds promising. One will bring some back for those old fossils, and all will be well...)

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Two boxes will do.

response.speaker: Fenglian
response.text: Wonderful! By the way, we're actually running a special Lantern Rite promotion. Buy three boxes, get ten percent off. Four boxes will net you twenty percent off...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: (Twenty percent off four boxes? This merchant strikes a fair bargain. One might as well give some to Morax and Ping too.)

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Then four shall suffice.

response.speaker: Fenglian
response.text: I see. Are you intending to give these as gifts? If so, perhaps I could interest you in these exquisite gift sets. Buy ten, get half off.

response.speaker: Fenglian
response.text: Look at the magnificent design! And the red ribbon gives quite the festive flair, don't you think? Such a gift would be sure to impress any lucky friend or family member.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: (Ten boxes... seems rather excessive. But if one factors in the Conqueror of Demons and one's disciples...)

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Fenglian
response.text: Ten! Nice round number, don't you think? 'Course you do. I'll even shave a little extra off the price for you.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: That is agreeable. One will... *ahem* I will have these boxed up, then.

response.speaker: Fenglian
response.text: Of course, of course. Right away!

response.speaker: Charbonnier
response.text: I see you have quite the eye for fine items, Mademoiselle. Perhaps some of my wares might also be of interest to you!

response.speaker: Charbonnier
response.text: I'm a toy merchant from Fontaine. You'll get nothing but the finest and most intricate clockwork toys Mora can buy here, each one sure to be a source of endless amusement...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: ...Hmph.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Perhaps you could enlighten me then. Whence should said amusement be derived?

response.speaker: Charbonnier
response.text: Well, uh... That is, of course, best understood by playing with them yourself! If you could wait just a moment, I can bring one out and give you a demonstration.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Ahem! There is no need for that.

response.speaker: Charbonnier
response.text: Uh, Mademoiselle...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Give me your newest and finest model — and be sure to package it securely.

response.speaker: Charbonnier
response.text: Ah, of course... Here you go.

response.speaker: Charbonnier
response.text: The instruction manual is...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: I can do without. Thank you.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: (Many watchful eyes surround this place. If one were to be spotted purchasing a mechanical toy such as this, a child's plaything no less, it would only invite scandal.)

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: (But there is no harm in bringing it back to study in secret...)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (I should head back before Xianyun notices...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Xianyun! Did your shopping go smoothly?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Naturally. One may not delight in social interactions, but that does not mean one lacks said faculties.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (It seems like Xianyun is easily swayed into buying things... That box looks fit to burst already.)

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: And you two? Are you not here to purchase things?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We just haven't had time yet. It doesn't look like there are any kite stalls around Yilong Wharf, but it does look like there are lots of goods from Fontaine.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: You are also planning to participate in the kite-flying competition, then?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Also...?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: *ahem* One means to say... You, along with all the other youths.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: One has been entreated to share one's kite-making expertise — and indeed, there was little one could do about such persistent supplication, one moment energetic and earnest, and dejected the next.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: One had no choice but to acquiesce to these requests, and thus, one will be organizing a kite-making workshop to provide personal instruction in this art form.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Who'll be participating, then?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Shuyu, Shenhe, Ganyu, and Yaoyao.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, that's quite a few people!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Also, this is all pretty well, Xianyun, but it's not like you have to make your own kite to participate in the competition. You can just buy one ready-made and call it a day.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Hah, you speak of those equipped with the mechanical lifting device, do you not? 'Tis nothing but a crude piece of mortal machinery.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: The mechanism that one has developed was the fruit of millennia of meticulous study. Let us not speak of the source of the mechanism's power, but rather its structure.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: It is composed of materials as light as bamboo and as strong as iron. This composition grants it the lightness of weight to ascend into the sky and the durability to follow the wind for many a mile. It is built with a series of intersecting rods that...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: ...*sigh* Never mind. It is unlikely the two of you will understand even should one expend the effort to explain. One is better off saving one's breath.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It sure seems like you want to talk about it though...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: ...So will you be attending the workshop or not?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Wait... You've been trying to invite us this entire time?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Seems interesting.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Alright then. No need to prepare the materials, in any case. One has it all sorted.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Arrive at Mt. Aocang in two days. I shall be expecting you around mid-day.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you leaving? Don't you want a guard to help you with that big box of yours?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Surely you jest. One goes as one pleases. For what reason would one need to rely on another?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh!? It can float? What kind of invention is that?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: One calls it the "Floating Toting Device."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Uh, she seems pretty proud of that one.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look at her walk down the street. She seems so confident, but everyone around her is looking at her all funny. Paimon wonders... Eh, never mind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #But anyway, {NICKNAME}, that box of hers seems to be full of those mechanical lifty thingamabobs!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not that Paimon was peeking or anything! She just, ah, got a bit unsteady for a second and accidentally brushed the embroidery on top.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And wouldn't you know it, all the stuff inside almost came bursting out! Paimon even went out of her way to keep it all together.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ah, what will I do about you, Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: All Paimon's saying is that Xianyun sure does try hard to save face.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What did she call it again? "A crude piece of mortal machinery"? Paimon bets she just can't wait to take it apart and see how it's made.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That does sound like something she would do.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Totally! We should probably act like we didn't see anything, though. You know, in consideration of her feelings and all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: After all, that is the "propriety with which one should comport oneself" when it comes to an elder, right?

choices.text: I'll leave the stuff-watching to you!

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Wow, you guys are good. I'm impressed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That was nothing! It was a piece of cake... Winter Melon Cake, to be exact, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: You really liked it, huh? You know what? I'll buy you a whole bunch and pile them so high you could swim in 'em.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As long you don't wind up drowning Paimon, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: By the way, do you know my aunt? Everyone calls her Granny Shan.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenyuan
dialogues.text: I've heard her mention Gaming before. Apparently, he's a nice, outgoing fellow and all-around good guy.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: Gaming is a good kid. I just wish he could reconcile with his family.

dialogues.speaker: Zhigui
dialogues.text: You're around the same age, so he might listen to you. Please talk things through with him.

dialogues.speaker: Fenglian
dialogues.text: Don't miss out on our Lantern Rite promotion! Only the best teas, sourced directly from Qiaoying Village. May I recommend the Sunglo variety...

dialogues.speaker: Fenglian
dialogues.text: Buy three boxes, get ten percent off, buy four, get twenty percent off... Buy ten, and you get half off.

dialogues.speaker: Charbonnier
dialogues.text: Um, so, that was a sale, somehow... What exactly are Liyue customers looking for, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Charbonnier
dialogues.text: Perhaps I should try running some sort of promotion...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You slowly lose yourself in the beauty of the surrounding scenery. Before you know it, you are greeted by the sight of Yilong Wharf.
